iteration.single_change: Add a multi-output pre-match phase-curve random forest. It learns gold and XP differences at 10, 15, 20, and 25 minutes as training targets from the committed pre-match model columns. Its eight out-of-sample predictions enter the hidden-world combiner. Observed checkpoints from the game being scored remain excluded. Rows missing a 25-minute checkpoint are censored and excluded from phase fitting without imputation.
